selector.rationale: The patient's presentation with a thick-walled, anechoic lesion and low-level internal echoes, along with the presence of turbid fluid upon aspiration, supports the diagnosis of an infected cyst. The contrast-enhanced CT findings of a well-defined, lobulated cystic lesion with a solid component also align with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Simple Hepatic Cyst
rejected.why: The presence of infection and thick-walled lesion does not support a simple cyst diagnosis

rejected.label: Infected Hepatic Cyst
rejected.why: While similar, the term 'infected non-parasitic cyst' is more specific and supported by the provided evidence

rejected.label: Pyogenic liver abscess
rejected.why: Although similar, the imaging findings and clinical presentation better support an infected cyst rather than a pyogenic abscess
